text:
maria (AE): quick heads up — northshore healthcare just escalated to execs. legal procurement paused the deal: they want SSO + clear data residency + an answer on encryption key control before the steering committee tomorrow morning.

anita (SE): copy. do we have a short blurb for SSO options? they mentioned okta specifically. also need the timeline for private deployment (VPC/on-prem).

mike (Infra Eng): we support SAML/OIDC with Okta out of the box. for private deployments we have two options: 1) VPC deployment in customer cloud (2-3 business days for config + networking) 2) on-prem appliance (pilot ~4-6 weeks depending on infra). both support KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, HSM).

raj (Security): adding security questionnaire guidance: we can confirm data at rest encryption using customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private. For hosted we use our KMS — we can provide CP/CSP attestation and SOC2 docs. they asked about key escrow — answer: "no escrow; keys remain customer-managed when using KMIP/HSM or cloud KMS in private mode."

anita (SE): can you paste the minimal SSO config snippet I can send to their IdP? 

mike (Infra Eng): sure — send them this:

```
EntityID: https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs
AssertionConsumerService: https://redwood.example.com/_saml/acs
NameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
Bindings: POST
```

mike (Infra Eng): also note: for SCIM provisioning we support the standard /scim/v2 endpoint.

maria (AE): procurement also asked whether we can sign a limited data residency SLA for PHI logs — they want confirmation that logs containing PHI will remain in-region.

raj (Security): we can commit to in-region logs for Private and Dedicated when deployed in their region. hosted customers — we can offer a contractual clause for region locking if they go on a dedicated instance. need legal to draft language.

cecilia (VP Sales): scheduling: I'll join the call with their CIS and Head of Security. maria, can you get me the exact list of questionnaire items they flagged? I want a 1-pager for execs with the recommended language + one-time concession (if any).

maria (AE): on it. they flagged about 12 Qs but priority is SSO, data residency, KMS control, SOC2 date, and breach notification SLA.

derek (RevOps): pricing note — they asked for ARR and a preferred billing term to justify discount. what band are we expecting? need to know if finance can approve a deal desk concession.

maria (AE): expected ARR ~$450k first year (pilot + seat expansion). they want a 20% sticker discount.

derek (RevOps): 20% is above standard for this ARR. my approval limit is 10%. if we need 20% we need CRO/CEO signoff. provide ARR and expansion plan in the ask.

cecilia (VP Sales): we can offer 12% as standard escalation. if legal/exec push, I'll escalate to CRO for the extra 8%. but we need the technical answers nailed first.

anita (SE): i'll draft the short tech one-pager (SSO config, SCIM, data residency options, KMS details, expected timelines). will drop a doc link in 45m.

raj (Security): i'll assemble security Q responses — SOC2 date + pen test cadence + incident playbook excerpt. quick answer to their "can we retain keys" question: yes for Private/Dedicated.

maria (AE): also asked about PII handling in logs and log retention policy. what's our recommended wording?

raj (Security): recommend: "We will configure log scrubbing to redact direct identifiers and configure retention policy per customer requirement; PHI-containing logs can be restricted to in-region Dedicated/Private deployments only."

docs-bot: New docs uploaded: https://internal.redwood/docs/presales/northshore-legal-answers-v1.pdf :page_facing_up:

maria (AE): thanks — i forwarded that to their procurement. meeting scheduled 2026-04-01 09:00 PT with their steering committee. cecilia, you confirmed you'll join?

cecilia (VP Sales): yes. please include me on the exec brief. put pricing ask and the 1-pager in the deck.

mike (Infra Eng): one more operational note: if we promise customer-managed keys we need a runbook for key rotation and ops access — i'll draft a short ops note for the legal team.

anita (SE): todo list summary: 1) anita — tech 1-pager (45m) 2) raj — security Q responses (2h) 3) mike — ops runbook snippet (end of day) 4) maria — consolidate and send to procurement + invite execs (ASAP) 5) derek/cecilia — confirm discount authority during call.

maria (AE): perfect. tagging next steps: @cecilia @derek @raj @anita @mike — please ping if any blocker. :thumbsup:
